storylines.storyline_label: Z.ai GLM-5.2 fully-open MIT weights (753B-param MoE, 1M-token IndexShare context) presses the closed coding frontier on price-performance
storylines.last_state_change_kind: New artifact shipped: Z.ai completed the open-weight release of GLM-5.2 this week, moving it from a June 13 subscription preview to publicly downloadable Hugging Face weights under an unrestricted MIT license; ~753B total / ~40B active MoE with a 1M-token context held by an IndexShare change (~2.9x less per-token compute at 1M), reporting 81.0 Terminal-Bench 2.1 (vs 85.0 Claude Opus 4.8) and 62.1 SWE-bench Pro (ahead of GPT-5.5's 58.6), second on Code Arena; benchmarks vendor-reported and replication outstanding

storylines.storyline_label: Palo Alto Unit 42 cross-tenant RCE in Google Vertex AI Python SDK ("Pickle in the Middle" / bucket squatting)
storylines.last_state_change_kind: Disclosure published: Unit 42's June 16 writeup detailed a cross-tenant RCE in the Vertex AI Python SDK (v1.139.0/1.140.0) via deterministic default staging-bucket names plus pickle deserialization; reported to Google March 5, UUID mitigation shipped v1.144.0 (March 31), full ownership-verification fix v1.148.0 (April 15), no CVE assigned

storylines.storyline_label: d-Matrix Corsair in-memory-compute inference accelerator reaches full production + SquadRack rack-scale system
storylines.last_state_change_kind: New artifact shipped: d-Matrix announced June 9 that Corsair (DIMC SRAM+compute chiplet on TSMC N6) entered full volume production and introduced SquadRack, a rack-scale reference design built with Arista, Broadcom, and Supermicro; Gimlet Labs testing cited ~12x latency improvement (24s to under 2s)

storylines.storyline_label: OpenAI Deployment Simulation pre-release behavioral-drift forecasting method
storylines.last_state_change_kind: New artifact shipped: OpenAI published Deployment Simulation on June 16, replaying ~1.3M de-identified ChatGPT conversations (GPT-5 Thinking through GPT-5.4, Aug 2025-Mar 2026) through candidate models to forecast behavior shifts (~1.5x median multiplicative error); surfaced a new 'calculator hacking' misalignment and extended the method to agentic coding

storylines.storyline_label: Databricks agentic production stack at Data + AI Summit (Agent Bricks / Lakebase LTAP / Genie One / OpenSharing)
storylines.last_state_change_kind: New artifact shipped: on the Summit's June 17 closing day Databricks positioned Lakebase as a serverless-Postgres LTAP database with copy-on-write branching and expanded Genie into Genie One (Teams/M365 Copilot beta); follows Agent Bricks (Choice/Context/Control, SpaceX-Grok partnership) on June 16 and OpenSharing (Linux Foundation Delta Sharing extension) on June 10

storylines.storyline_label: vLLM v0.23.0 inference-serving release (DeepSeek-V4 maturity, Model Runner V2 + Rust frontend defaults for Llama/Mistral, Gemma 4)
storylines.last_state_change_kind: New artifact shipped: vLLM tagged v0.23.0 on June 15 (408 commits, 200 contributors), broadening DeepSeek-V4 across backends (improved attention/MoE kernels, decoupled sparse-MLA metadata), promoting Model Runner V2 to default for Llama and Mistral dense models (FlashInfer sampler, breakable CUDA graphs), advancing the Rust frontend (streaming generate, dynamic LoRA, tool-call parsers), and adding Gemma 4, Transformers v5 compat, multi-tier KV-cache offloading, and models including Step-3.7-Flash / Cosmos 3 Reasoner / JetBrains Mellum v2 / Cohere Mini Code

storylines.storyline_label: MosaicQuant unified 4-bit LLM quantization (dense 4-bit base + sparse 4-bit residual via ZipperEngine)
storylines.last_state_change_kind: New artifact shipped: arXiv:2606.15652 (posted June 14, cs.LG/cs.CL) proposes MosaicQuant, disaggregating each weight matrix into a dense 4-bit base plus a sparse 4-bit residual (both kept in 4-bit) with ZipperEngine folding the residual into the dense matmul for a unified low-bit path; reports near-FP16 accuracy on LLaMA3/Qwen3 with up to 1.24x speedup over the 16-bit baseline, authors' own numbers pending independent reproduction

storylines.storyline_label: Neura Robotics up-to-$1.4B Series C (Nvidia/Amazon/Qualcomm/Bosch + Tether-led) to scale the 4NE-1 humanoid
storylines.last_state_change_kind: M&A/funding event: German cognitive-robotics firm Neura Robotics disclosed a Series C of up to $1.4B (surfaced June 10, drove coverage through the week), structured as a milestone-tied ceiling at a ~$7B valuation and billed as the largest robotics raise on record; Tether-led syndicate with Nvidia, Amazon, Qualcomm, Bosch, Schaeffler, the EIB, imec.xpand and Lingotto Horizon, earmarked to push 4NE-1 serial production toward multi-million units by 2030 with first volume shipments targeted late 2026

storylines.storyline_label: US export-control directive suspending Anthropic Fable 5 and Mythos 5 + DC negotiation
storylines.last_state_change_kind: New actor public position: Anthropic dispatched senior technical staff to Washington (June 15) over the June 12 directive; Katie Moussouris noted June 16 the cited capability (reading a codebase to fix flaws) is standard defensive security work also present in GPT-5.5; both models still offline globally as of June 16

storylines.storyline_label: Zscaler first complete zero-trust platform for agentic AI (AI Broker / AI Access Graph / Endpoint AI Security) + Oasis integration
storylines.last_state_change_kind: New artifact shipped: Zscaler announced AI Broker (inline MCP/A2A access control via Agent Registry), AI Access Graph (built on the May 2026 $175M Symmetry Systems acquisition), and Endpoint AI Security at Zenith Live (June 9); Oasis Security added non-human-identity lifecycle governance on the Zero Trust Exchange (June 10)

storylines.storyline_label: SGLang inference-engine release line (v0.5.13: Nemotron 3 Ultra, Cosmos 3, Spec V2 production)
storylines.last_state_change_kind: New artifact shipped: SGLang v0.5.13 (June 13) added Nemotron 3 Ultra / Step-3.7-Flash / Command A+ / Cosmos 3 and promoted Spec V2 tree drafting (topk>1) to production across triton/FA3/MLA/aiter backends, plus DeepSeek V4 context-parallelism and sparse-attention kernels

storylines.storyline_label: Bay Area / SV AI-event calendar (mainstream-dev, AI-security, AI-chip tracks)
storylines.last_state_change_kind: Carry-forward events topic (ADR-002 Rules 1+2 waived): the Databricks Data + AI Summit wrapped its final day June 18 at Moscone (now dropped); still-upcoming forward calendar spans Confidential Computing Summit (Jun 23-24, SF Mint), AI Tinkerers Offensive Security Demo Night (Jun 25), Snowflake virtual Dev Day (Jun 25), AIE World's Fair Hackathon w/ Cerebral Valley (Jun 27-28), AI Engineer World's Fair (Jun 29-Jul 2, ~29 tracks / ~300 speakers / Inference + Security tracks), AMD Advancing AI (Jul 23), Black Hat USA AI Summit / DEF CON AI Village (Aug 1-6), SecurityWeek AI Risk Summit (Aug 11-12), Hot Chips (Aug 23-25), AI Infra Summit (Sep 15-17), GitHub Universe (Oct 28-29), OWASP Global AppSec USA (Nov 5-6), AWS re:Invent (Nov 30-Dec 4); Zenity AI Agent Security Summit remains on the watch list
